quote.exact: not going into the heart of it

annotations.note: Most East Coast amphibious crews of this period went to North Africa. Tom was hinting (within censorship rules) that his crew was headed elsewhere: the Gulf, and then the Pacific.

quote.exact: likes the Chinks, but not the Japs

annotations.note: Ethnic slurs for Chinese and Japanese people, common in 1940s America. Kept as written.
